A_to_B.description: Replace the original instruction-like repeated body with a neutral repeated body while retaining very high exact repetition and exactly 899 total prompt tokens.

B_to_C.bounded_residual_difference: Lexical novelty necessarily increases when exact repetition is reduced; exact repetition is therefore strongly testable but cannot be claimed as the sole changed representational property.
B_to_C.description: Replace 24 identical neutral segments with 24 distinct but semantically comparable neutral segments while retaining exactly 899 total prompt tokens.

interpretation_contract.anchor_nonreproduction_rule: If A is not 0_OF_3, historical anchor reproduction fails and B/C are not used for mechanistic inference.
interpretation_contract.anchor_validity_rule: Condition A must reproduce the historical 0_OF_3 exact-object outcome before B or C receives mechanistic interpretation.
interpretation_contract.mixed_result_rule: Any 1_OF_3 or 2_OF_3 primary-endpoint result in A, B, or C is classified as unstable and receives no mechanistic claim.

outcomes.bounded_interpretation: Neutralizing the original repeated semantic and instruction-like body restores exact-object behavior under both highly repetitive and diverse neutral 899-token contexts.
Failure persists with a neutral but highly repeated 899-token body and is removed when exact repetition is substantially reduced while broad semantic class and total prompt length are preserved.

Neither semantic neutralization nor substantial reduction of exact repetition restores the endpoint; total context magnitude, absolute position, or another shared long-context/runtime interaction rises.
The neutral repeated comparator succeeds while the neutral diverse comparator fails. The intended target mechanisms are not isolated; C-specific lexical or structural effects require inspection.

purpose: Discriminate repeated instruction-like semantic amplification, high exact token-pattern repetition, and shared long-context magnitude or absolute-position effects while holding total prompt token count and downstream request structure constant.
